title: Completed local ring, split-node ring and geometric-fibre projection
statement: For a scheme $F$ [def-pc-scheme] and a point $z\in F$, write $A=\mathcal O_{F,z}$ and $\mathfrak m_z$ for its maximal ideal. Define its completed local ring to be $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,z}=\varprojlim_n A/\mathfrak m_z^n$, the maximal-ideal adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], with its componentwise commutative-ring structure. For a commutative ring $\Omega$, define the split-node ring to be $N_\Omega=\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$, the quotient of the two-variable formal power series ring [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] by the ideal generated by $uv$, with its quotient ring structure. Given schemes $X,S$, a morphism $f:X\to S$, a field $\Omega$ [def-weil-field] and a map $g:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], define the canonical projection $\operatorname{pr}_{f,g}:X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ to be the second fibre-product projection; for algebraically closed $\Omega$ this is the geometric-fibre projection [def-weil-geometric-fibre].
